countermeasures.name: Adversarial Training & Robust Optimization
countermeasures.description: Train or fine-tune the model with adversarial examples or robust optimization techniques so it becomes less sensitive to small input perturbations.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Use established libraries and validate that clinical performance metrics remain acceptable.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Strong adaptive attacks may still succeed; robustness is rarely absolute.

countermeasures.name: Input Sanitization & Anomaly Detection
countermeasures.description: Detect and reject or flag statistically anomalous inputs before they reach the model.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Statistical or autoencoder-based detectors on image/signal features.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Sophisticated attacks can evade detectors; false positives may disrupt workflow.

countermeasures.name: Certified Robustness / Randomized Smoothing
countermeasures.description: Apply techniques that provide formal guarantees on robustness within a defined radius.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Computationally expensive; suitable mainly for high-risk decisions.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Guarantees are limited to specific threat models and radii.

countermeasures.name: Ensemble or Multi-Model Consensus
countermeasures.description: Require agreement across multiple independently trained models before issuing a high-stakes output.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Increases compute and latency.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Correlated failures possible if models share training data or architecture.

countermeasures.name: Human-in-the-Loop Review for Borderline Cases
countermeasures.description: Route low-confidence or flagged predictions to a clinician for confirmation.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Define clear thresholds and escalation paths.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Depends on clinician availability and attention.

countermeasures.name: Strict Training Data Provenance & Access Controls
countermeasures.description: Maintain audited, access-controlled pipelines for all training and fine-tuning data.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Versioned datasets, cryptographic hashes, role-based access.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Insider threats or compromised upstream sources remain possible.

countermeasures.name: Data Validation & Outlier Filtering
countermeasures.description: Automatically detect and quarantine suspicious or statistically anomalous samples before training.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Statistical tests, embedding-space outlier detection.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Subtle poisoning can still pass filters.

countermeasures.name: Secure Model Registry & Signing
countermeasures.description: Store models in a signed, access-controlled registry; verify signatures before deployment.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Integrate with existing CI/CD and SBOM practices.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Compromised signing keys break the control.

countermeasures.name: Periodic Retraining from Trusted Baselines
countermeasures.description: Retrain or roll back to known-good model versions on a defined schedule or after detected anomalies.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Requires reproducible training pipelines.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Detection lag before rollback occurs.

countermeasures.name: Differential Privacy or Noise Injection during Training
countermeasures.description: Limit the influence of any single training example.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Trade-off with model utility; tune privacy budget carefully.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Strong privacy can degrade performance on rare conditions.

countermeasures.name: Differential Privacy (Training & Query)
countermeasures.description: Apply DP mechanisms during training and/or at inference to bound information leakage.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Choose appropriate ε; validate clinical utility.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Utility loss; composition of queries can erode protection.

countermeasures.name: Output Perturbation / Confidence Calibration
countermeasures.description: Add calibrated noise or suppress overly precise outputs that enable inversion.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Especially useful for generative or high-dimensional outputs.
countermeasures.residual_risk: May reduce clinical usefulness of fine-grained results.

countermeasures.name: Access Control & Query Auditing
countermeasures.description: Restrict who can query the model and log all inference requests with purpose binding.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Integrate with hospital identity systems.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Insider abuse still possible.

countermeasures.name: Model Hardening against Membership Inference
countermeasures.description: Use regularization, distillation, or adversarial training targeted at membership inference.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Test with standard MIA attack suites.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Newer attacks may bypass current defenses.

countermeasures.name: Data Minimization & Purpose Limitation
countermeasures.description: Train and operate with the minimum necessary personal data; avoid retaining raw identifiers.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Align with privacy regulations and institutional policies.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Some clinical use cases require richer data.

countermeasures.name: Continuous Performance Monitoring
countermeasures.description: Track key metrics (accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, calibration) on live or shadow data.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Define alert thresholds and statistical process control limits.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Detection lag; requires representative monitoring data.

countermeasures.name: Domain Adaptation / Scheduled Retraining
countermeasures.description: Retrain or adapt the model when drift is detected or on a fixed cadence.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Requires approved change-control process (e.g., PCCP).
countermeasures.residual_risk: Retraining can introduce new failure modes.

countermeasures.name: Out-of-Distribution Detection
countermeasures.description: Flag inputs that fall outside the training distribution before relying on the prediction.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Use uncertainty estimation or dedicated OOD detectors.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Threshold tuning is difficult; false alarms possible.

countermeasures.name: Robustness Testing Across Sites & Populations
countermeasures.description: Validate performance on data from multiple institutions and demographic groups before release.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Part of premarket and post-market evidence.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Cannot cover every future shift.

countermeasures.name: Fallback to Conservative Clinical Pathways
countermeasures.description: When drift or low confidence is detected, default to standard non-AI workflows.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Pre-define the fallback rules with clinical stakeholders.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Fallback itself may have capacity limits.

countermeasures.name: Stratified Performance Evaluation
countermeasures.description: Measure and report metrics across relevant demographic and clinical subgroups.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Require minimum sample sizes per group.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Some subgroups remain under-powered.

countermeasures.name: Reweighting / Resampling / Fairness Constraints
countermeasures.description: Adjust training to reduce performance disparities.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Multiple technical approaches exist; validate overall utility.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Fairness–accuracy trade-offs are common.

countermeasures.name: Ongoing Bias Monitoring in Production
countermeasures.description: Continuously track subgroup performance on live data.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Privacy-preserving aggregation often required.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Delayed detection of emerging bias.

countermeasures.name: Clinical Oversight of High-Impact Decisions
countermeasures.description: Require human review for predictions that could disproportionately affect certain groups.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Define clear escalation criteria.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Human reviewers can also carry bias.

countermeasures.name: Transparent Reporting of Limitations
countermeasures.description: Clearly document known performance differences in labeling and instructions for use.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Regulatory expectation in many jurisdictions.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Users may still overlook the information.

countermeasures.name: Early Clinical Workflow Mapping
countermeasures.description: Conduct structured workflow analysis with end users before final design lock.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Include nurses, technicians, and IT stakeholders.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Workflows change over time.

countermeasures.name: Seamless EHR / PACS Integration Testing
countermeasures.description: Validate end-to-end data flow and latency under realistic hospital conditions.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Use staging environments that mirror production.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Site-specific configurations still cause issues.

countermeasures.name: Graceful Degradation Modes
countermeasures.description: Design the system to continue providing partial value when upstream data or services fail.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Define what “degraded” means clinically.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Users may not notice degradation.

countermeasures.name: Change Management & Training Programs
countermeasures.description: Provide role-specific training and update materials when the device or workflow changes.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Track completion and competency.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Training decays; staff turnover is high.

countermeasures.name: Real-time Status Dashboards
countermeasures.description: Surface system health, data freshness, and integration status to clinical and IT users.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Keep the interface simple.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Alert fatigue if poorly tuned.

countermeasures.name: Human Factors Engineering & Usability Testing
countermeasures.description: Conduct formal usability studies with representative users under realistic conditions.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Follow recognized standards (e.g., IEC 62366).
countermeasures.residual_risk: Lab testing does not capture all real-world pressures.

countermeasures.name: Clear Confidence & Uncertainty Display
countermeasures.description: Present model confidence and known limitations in a clinically understandable way.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Avoid over-precision.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Users may still over-trust high-confidence outputs.

countermeasures.name: Alert Management & Fatigue Controls
countermeasures.description: Design alert thresholds, prioritization, and suppression rules carefully.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Involve clinical safety committees.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Over-suppression can hide true positives.

countermeasures.name: Mandatory Confirmation for High-Risk Actions
countermeasures.description: Require explicit clinician confirmation before acting on certain AI recommendations.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Balance safety with workflow friction.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Confirmation can become rote.

countermeasures.name: Post-deployment Use Monitoring
countermeasures.description: Track patterns of override, acceptance, and near-miss events.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Combine quantitative logs with qualitative feedback.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Under-reporting is common.

countermeasures.name: Redundancy & Failover Architecture
countermeasures.description: Deploy critical components with geographic or instance-level redundancy.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Align with hospital business-continuity plans.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Correlated failures (e.g., cloud region outage).

countermeasures.name: Rate Limiting & Resource Isolation
countermeasures.description: Protect inference endpoints from resource exhaustion.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Apply at API gateway and model-serving layers.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Legitimate traffic spikes can still be affected.

countermeasures.name: Health Checks & Automated Recovery
countermeasures.description: Continuously monitor service health and restart or fail over automatically.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Define clear recovery time objectives.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Recovery may not be instantaneous.

countermeasures.name: Offline / Cached Fallback Mode
countermeasures.description: Provide a limited local capability when connectivity or central services are lost.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Suitable mainly for certain device types.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Offline mode has reduced functionality.

countermeasures.name: Capacity Planning & Load Testing
countermeasures.description: Regularly test under expected and peak clinical loads.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Include realistic data volumes and concurrent users.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Future growth can exceed plans.

countermeasures.name: Strong Authentication & MFA
countermeasures.description: Require multi-factor authentication for administrative and high-privilege functions.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Integrate with enterprise identity providers.
countermeasures.residual_risk: MFA fatigue or social engineering.

countermeasures.name: Least-Privilege Access & Role-Based Controls
countermeasures.description: Grant only the minimum permissions required for each role.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Regular access reviews.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Privilege creep over time.

countermeasures.name: Comprehensive Audit Logging
countermeasures.description: Log authentication events, configuration changes, and privileged actions.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Protect logs from tampering; retain per policy.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Logs are only useful if monitored.

countermeasures.name: Network Segmentation & Zero-Trust Principles
countermeasures.description: Isolate device and model-serving components from general hospital networks.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Micro-segmentation where feasible.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Complex environments are hard to segment perfectly.

countermeasures.name: Just-in-Time Privileged Access
countermeasures.description: Elevate privileges only for limited time windows with approval.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Useful for maintenance and support accounts.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Emergency access procedures can be abused.

countermeasures.name: Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) & Component Tracking
countermeasures.description: Maintain an up-to-date SBOM for all software and model components.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Automate generation and vulnerability scanning.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Incomplete or outdated SBOMs reduce value.

countermeasures.name: Signed Updates & Secure Delivery
countermeasures.description: Cryptographically sign all model and software updates; verify before installation.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Protect signing keys rigorously.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Compromised keys undermine the control.

countermeasures.name: Vendor Risk Assessment & Contractual Controls
countermeasures.description: Evaluate third-party model and software suppliers for security practices.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Include right-to-audit and notification clauses.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Smaller vendors may have limited maturity.

countermeasures.name: Staged Rollout & Canary Deployments
countermeasures.description: Deploy updates to a small cohort first and monitor before full release.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Define clear rollback criteria.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Some issues appear only at scale.

countermeasures.name: Vulnerability Monitoring & Rapid Patching Process
countermeasures.description: Continuously monitor for new vulnerabilities in dependencies and have a tested patch process.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Align with FDA post-market cybersecurity expectations.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Zero-days and slow vendor patches remain challenges.

countermeasures.name: Automated Input Data Validation
countermeasures.description: Check incoming clinical data for completeness, format, range validity, and basic consistency.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Reject or flag non-conformant inputs.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Semantic errors can still pass syntactic checks.

countermeasures.name: Data Quality Dashboards & Feedback Loops
countermeasures.description: Surface data-quality metrics to clinical and technical owners.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Close the loop with data-producing departments.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Requires organizational ownership.

countermeasures.name: Representative Dataset Curation
countermeasures.description: Intentionally construct training and validation sets that reflect the intended use population.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Document inclusion/exclusion criteria and known gaps.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Future population shifts are inevitable.

countermeasures.name: Missing-Data Handling Strategies
countermeasures.description: Define and validate explicit policies for missing or partial inputs.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Prefer clinically safe defaults.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Imputation can introduce bias.

countermeasures.name: Site-Specific Calibration or Fine-Tuning
countermeasures.description: Allow controlled local adaptation when data characteristics differ significantly.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Must stay within regulatory change-control boundaries.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Local models can drift from the validated baseline.

countermeasures.name: Clinically Meaningful Explanation Methods
countermeasures.description: Provide explanations (e.g., feature attributions, similar cases, rule approximations) that clinicians can actually use.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Validate that explanations improve decision quality.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Many explanation methods are themselves imperfect or unstable.

countermeasures.name: Uncertainty Quantification
countermeasures.description: Surface reliable confidence or uncertainty estimates with every prediction.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Calibrate thoroughly.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Users may still misinterpret confidence.

countermeasures.name: Model Cards & Clear Documentation
countermeasures.description: Maintain concise, accessible documentation of intended use, performance, limitations, and failure modes.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Keep documentation synchronized with model versions.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Documentation is often ignored under time pressure.

countermeasures.name: Explanation Consistency Monitoring
countermeasures.description: Track whether explanations remain stable for similar inputs over time.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Useful for detecting model or data drift.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Extra computational overhead.

countermeasures.name: Training on Explanation Use
countermeasures.description: Train clinical users on how to interpret and when to question model explanations.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Include in onboarding and refresher programs.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Training effectiveness varies.

countermeasures.name: Hazard Analysis & Safety Risk Controls
countermeasures.description: Identify credible hazardous situations and implement design controls that reduce the probability or severity of patient harm.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Link hazards, foreseeable sequences of events, risk controls, verification evidence, and residual-risk acceptance in the risk-management file.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Unanticipated use conditions or combinations of failures can still produce harm.

countermeasures.name: Independent Safety Limits & Interlocks
countermeasures.description: Enforce hard safety bounds independently of the primary software or model decision path.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Use independent range checks, dose/energy limits, watchdogs, mechanical stops, or secondary validation where appropriate.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Incorrectly specified limits or common-mode failures can defeat the safeguard.

countermeasures.name: Fail-Safe / Safe-State Behavior
countermeasures.description: Move the device or workflow to a clinically safe state when critical faults or uncertainty are detected.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Define the safe state for each operating mode and verify transitions under fault conditions.
countermeasures.residual_risk: A safe state may still interrupt treatment or be unavailable in time-critical situations.

countermeasures.name: Clinical Alarm & Escalation Controls
countermeasures.description: Detect safety-relevant failures and escalate them promptly to an appropriate clinician or operator.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Prioritize alarms by clinical urgency and validate alarm comprehension and response time.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Alarm fatigue, delayed response, or unavailable staff can reduce effectiveness.

countermeasures.name: Safety Verification Under Fault Conditions
countermeasures.description: Test device behavior under realistic single faults, degraded inputs, misuse, and foreseeable combinations of failures.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Include boundary conditions, interrupted workflows, corrupted inputs, sensor faults, and recovery behavior.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Testing cannot exhaust all real-world combinations.

countermeasures.name: Occupational Hazard Assessment
countermeasures.description: Identify hazards to clinicians, technicians, caregivers, maintenance staff, and bystanders during normal use and servicing.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Include electrical, mechanical, radiation, thermal, biological, ergonomic, and environmental hazards as applicable.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Rare service or misuse scenarios may not be fully characterized.

countermeasures.name: Physical Guards, Isolation & Interlocks
countermeasures.description: Use physical or logical safeguards to prevent personnel exposure to hazardous device states.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Examples include covers, lockouts, access interlocks, shielding, and maintenance-mode restrictions.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Safeguards may be bypassed during servicing or emergency operation.

countermeasures.name: Service and Maintenance Safety Procedures
countermeasures.description: Define controlled procedures for installation, calibration, repair, cleaning, and maintenance.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Include competency requirements, lockout/tagout where relevant, and verification after service.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Procedural controls depend on human compliance.

countermeasures.name: Exposure Monitoring & Incident Detection
countermeasures.description: Monitor for conditions that could expose staff or bystanders to unsafe energy, substances, or device behavior.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Use sensors, self-tests, event logs, or environmental monitoring where practical.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Some harmful exposures may occur before detection.

countermeasures.name: Emergency Shutdown / Isolation
countermeasures.description: Provide a clear method to stop or isolate hazardous operation without creating a greater clinical hazard.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Make emergency controls accessible, unambiguous, and periodically tested.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Shutdown may itself interrupt necessary care.

countermeasures.name: Versioned Backups & Point-in-Time Recovery
countermeasures.description: Maintain protected backups of clinically and operationally important data with tested restoration procedures.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Use immutable or isolated backup copies where feasible and define recovery-point objectives.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Recent data may still be lost between recovery points.

countermeasures.name: Integrity Checks & Transactional Writes
countermeasures.description: Detect incomplete, corrupted, or inconsistent writes and prevent partially committed clinical state.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Use checksums, database constraints, transactions, journaling, and schema validation.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Semantically incorrect but structurally valid data can remain undetected.

countermeasures.name: Redundant Storage & Replication
countermeasures.description: Replicate important data across independent storage domains to tolerate local failure.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Avoid correlated failure modes and monitor replication lag and health.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Corruption can replicate if not detected early.

countermeasures.name: Deletion Protection & Retention Controls
countermeasures.description: Prevent accidental or unauthorized deletion of records, logs, models, and configuration.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Use role restrictions, soft deletion, retention locks, and approval for destructive operations.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Privileged compromise or misconfigured retention can still cause loss.

countermeasures.name: Routine Restore & Disaster-Recovery Testing
countermeasures.description: Regularly verify that backups, replicas, and recovery procedures can restore usable data within required time objectives.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Test complete recovery workflows, not only backup job completion.
countermeasures.residual_risk: A real incident may differ materially from test scenarios.

countermeasures.name: Dependency Inventory & Criticality Mapping
countermeasures.description: Maintain an inventory of cloud, SaaS, API, identity, messaging, and remote-processing dependencies and their clinical criticality.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Document owner, purpose, failure mode, SLA, data exchanged, and fallback for each dependency.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Undocumented transitive dependencies may remain.

countermeasures.name: Timeouts, Circuit Breakers & Graceful Degradation
countermeasures.description: Prevent external service failures from cascading through the device or clinical workflow.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Use bounded retries, explicit timeouts, circuit breakers, cached state, and reduced-function modes.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Degraded mode may not support all clinically important functions.

countermeasures.name: Multi-Zone / Multi-Region Resilience for Critical Services
countermeasures.description: Avoid single cloud availability-zone or region dependencies for clinically critical functions.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Validate failover, state replication, and operational procedures.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Provider-wide or account-level failures can still affect all regions.

countermeasures.name: External Service Health Monitoring
countermeasures.description: Continuously measure dependency health, latency, error rates, and data freshness.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Alert on clinically meaningful degradation rather than infrastructure noise alone.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Detection does not guarantee timely recovery.

countermeasures.name: Provider Exit / Substitution Plan
countermeasures.description: Maintain a feasible path to replace or bypass a critical external provider.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Address data export, alternate vendors, configuration portability, credentials, and validation requirements.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Migration may be slow or operationally difficult during an active outage.

countermeasures.name: Independent Clinical Plausibility Checks
countermeasures.description: Check outputs against clinically plausible ranges, known contraindications, and consistency with available patient context.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Keep safety rules independently testable from the primary model or algorithm.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Novel or unusual cases may legitimately violate expected patterns.

countermeasures.name: Human Confirmation for High-Consequence Decisions
countermeasures.description: Require qualified review before acting on outputs that can directly cause diagnosis, triage, treatment, or intervention.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Define which actions require confirmation and avoid making confirmation a meaningless click-through.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Clinicians may inherit or amplify the original error.

countermeasures.name: Reference-Standard Validation
countermeasures.description: Validate clinically important outputs against an appropriate reference standard under intended-use conditions.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Include clinically meaningful performance endpoints, not only technical accuracy metrics.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Reference standards themselves may contain uncertainty or bias.

countermeasures.name: Result Provenance & Context Display
countermeasures.description: Present enough source, timing, patient, device, and confidence context for users to judge whether a result is applicable.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Make stale, incomplete, or out-of-scope inputs conspicuous.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Users can still overlook or misinterpret context.

countermeasures.name: Outcome / Near-Miss Surveillance
countermeasures.description: Monitor adverse outcomes, overrides, disagreements, and near misses to identify systematic decision errors after deployment.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Feed findings into CAPA, labeling, model updates, and risk-management review.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Outcome attribution can be difficult and reporting incomplete.

countermeasures.name: Requirements-to-Control Traceability
countermeasures.description: Map applicable regulatory, quality, safety, cybersecurity, and privacy requirements to implemented controls and objective evidence.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Maintain traceability through design changes and software releases.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Requirements can be misinterpreted or change over time.

countermeasures.name: Controlled Documentation & Records
countermeasures.description: Maintain approved, version-controlled procedures, specifications, risk records, test evidence, and required operational records.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Define ownership, approval, retention, and change-control rules.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Documentation may lag actual practice.

countermeasures.name: Audit Readiness & Evidence Retention
countermeasures.description: Retain accessible evidence needed to demonstrate compliance, investigate incidents, and support inspections.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Periodically sample records for completeness and retrievability.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Evidence can be incomplete despite formal processes.

countermeasures.name: CAPA / Nonconformance Process
countermeasures.description: Systematically investigate significant failures, determine root cause, implement corrective action, and verify effectiveness.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Use risk-based escalation criteria and trend recurring issues.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Poor root-cause analysis can result in ineffective CAPA.

countermeasures.name: Regulatory Change Assessment
countermeasures.description: Assess whether product, model, infrastructure, intended-use, or supplier changes trigger new validation, documentation, or regulatory obligations.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Integrate the assessment into engineering and release workflows.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Novel changes may fall into ambiguous regulatory territory.

countermeasures.name: Tamper-Evident Audit Logging
countermeasures.description: Record security-, clinical-, and configuration-relevant actions in a way that makes unauthorized modification detectable.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Protect log integrity, synchronize time, and restrict log administration.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Events not instrumented cannot be reconstructed.

countermeasures.name: Unique User / Service Identity
countermeasures.description: Attribute material actions to unique human or machine identities rather than shared accounts.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Use managed service identities and prohibit shared privileged credentials where practical.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Credential theft can still misattribute actions.

countermeasures.name: Configuration & Model Provenance
countermeasures.description: Record which software, model, rules, configuration, and data versions produced a clinically relevant output.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Use immutable version identifiers and release manifests.
countermeasures.residual_risk: External inputs may lack equivalent provenance.

countermeasures.name: Time Synchronization & Event Correlation
countermeasures.description: Maintain reliable timestamps so events across device, cloud, network, and clinical systems can be correlated.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Monitor clock drift and define behavior when trustworthy time is unavailable.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Offline systems may temporarily lose synchronization.

countermeasures.name: Log Review & Investigation Procedures
countermeasures.description: Define how audit records are reviewed, escalated, preserved, and used during safety, security, and compliance investigations.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Prioritize high-value events and automate correlation where possible.
countermeasures.residual_risk: High event volume can obscure relevant evidence.

countermeasures.name: Interface Contract & Schema Validation
countermeasures.description: Validate messages, fields, units, identifiers, ranges, and required semantics at system boundaries.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Version interface contracts and reject or quarantine incompatible messages.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Semantically wrong values can still conform to a schema.

countermeasures.name: End-to-End Integration Testing
countermeasures.description: Test complete workflows across devices, EHR, PACS, LIS, gateways, cloud services, and other connected systems.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Include site-specific configuration, latency, network interruption, retries, and duplicate messages.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Production environments may contain untested combinations.

countermeasures.name: Patient / Study / Encounter Identity Reconciliation
countermeasures.description: Verify that exchanged data is bound to the correct patient, study, encounter, specimen, or procedure.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Use stable identifiers and explicit mismatch handling.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Errors originating upstream may be difficult to resolve automatically.

countermeasures.name: Acknowledgement, Retry & Idempotency Controls
countermeasures.description: Ensure interrupted communications do not silently drop, duplicate, or reorder clinically important transactions.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Use durable queues, delivery acknowledgements, idempotent processing, and bounded retry policies.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Network partitions can still delay time-sensitive data.

countermeasures.name: Interface Health & Data-Freshness Monitoring
countermeasures.description: Detect stalled interfaces, abnormal error rates, stale data, or unexpected message-volume changes.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Expose clinically relevant status to operators and downstream applications.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Monitoring may detect but not automatically correct interoperability defects.

countermeasures.name: Access Segmentation for Proprietary Assets
countermeasures.description: Restrict models, source code, algorithms, proprietary datasets, keys, and design artifacts to authorized roles and systems.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Separate development, production, support, and customer-access paths.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Authorized insiders may still exfiltrate information.

countermeasures.name: Encryption & Key Protection
countermeasures.description: Protect proprietary assets in transit and at rest with appropriately managed encryption keys.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Use hardware-backed or managed key services for high-value secrets where practical.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Compromised endpoints can access decrypted data.

countermeasures.name: Model / API Extraction Resistance
countermeasures.description: Limit automated extraction or replication of proprietary model behavior through exposed interfaces.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Use authentication, quotas, anomaly detection, response minimization, and contract controls.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Legitimate usage can still reveal significant model behavior.

countermeasures.name: Repository & Artifact Monitoring
countermeasures.description: Monitor source repositories, build artifacts, model registries, and data stores for unauthorized access or bulk export.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Alert on unusual clones, downloads, token use, or cross-boundary transfers.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Low-and-slow theft may evade thresholds.

countermeasures.name: Secret and Credential Scanning
countermeasures.description: Detect credentials, private keys, proprietary data, and sensitive configuration accidentally embedded in code or distributable artifacts.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Scan commits, CI artifacts, containers, packages, and release images.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Custom or obfuscated sensitive material may not match scanning rules.

countermeasures.name: Business Impact & Criticality Analysis
countermeasures.description: Identify failure scenarios that can create material revenue, contractual, recall, service-credit, remediation, or customer-retention impact.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Tie technical dependencies to business processes and quantify impact where feasible.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Indirect commercial effects are difficult to estimate precisely.

countermeasures.name: Contractual Risk Allocation
countermeasures.description: Define responsibilities, warranties, incident obligations, service levels, liability boundaries, and supplier remedies contractually.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Align contract terms with realistic technical controls and insurance coverage.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Contractual recovery may be slow or incomplete.

countermeasures.name: Business Continuity & Revenue-Critical Recovery
countermeasures.description: Prioritize recovery of services, functions, and customers according to financial and contractual criticality.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Integrate commercial priorities into disaster-recovery exercises.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Large-scale incidents can exceed continuity assumptions.

countermeasures.name: Incident Cost Tracking & Escalation
countermeasures.description: Track direct and projected incident costs so management can escalate remediation before losses compound.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Include support burden, customer credits, lost sales, legal cost, recall exposure, and engineering effort.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Long-tail losses can emerge after the incident closes.

countermeasures.name: Customer / Supplier Concentration Controls
countermeasures.description: Reduce dependence on single customers, providers, channels, or suppliers where failure would create disproportionate commercial damage.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Use alternate suppliers, portability, negotiated protections, or contingency capacity where justified.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Some specialized dependencies may have no practical substitute.

countermeasures.name: Transparent Incident Communication Plan
countermeasures.description: Prepare factual, timely communication workflows for customers, clinicians, patients, regulators, and partners after material incidents.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Predefine ownership, approval paths, notification thresholds, and evidence requirements.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Communication cannot fully reverse loss of trust after a serious event.

countermeasures.name: Safety / Security Claim Review
countermeasures.description: Review public, sales, clinical, and regulatory claims to ensure they accurately reflect validated capabilities and limitations.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Use cross-functional approval for high-risk claims.
countermeasures.residual_risk: External parties may still interpret accurate statements differently.

countermeasures.name: Customer-Facing Reliability & Security Evidence
countermeasures.description: Provide credible evidence of testing, monitoring, response capability, and corrective action to customers and partners.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Keep evidence current and consistent with actual product state.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Evidence loses value if operational performance contradicts it.

countermeasures.name: Complaint / Sentiment Trend Monitoring
countermeasures.description: Monitor complaints, support tickets, adverse-event signals, customer escalations, and other trust indicators for emerging patterns.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Link trend thresholds to quality and management escalation.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Public trust can deteriorate faster than formal monitoring detects.

countermeasures.name: Post-Incident Corrective Action Disclosure
countermeasures.description: When appropriate, communicate verified corrective actions and prevention measures after a significant failure.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Coordinate legal, regulatory, quality, security, and commercial stakeholders.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Stakeholders may remain skeptical despite effective remediation.

countermeasures.name: Power Conditioning & Backup Power
countermeasures.description: Protect critical functions from power loss, brownouts, surges, and unstable facility power.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Use batteries, UPS, graceful shutdown, and validated restart behavior as appropriate.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Extended outages may exceed backup duration.

countermeasures.name: Environmental Operating-Range Monitoring
countermeasures.description: Detect temperature, humidity, vibration, electromagnetic, or other environmental conditions outside validated limits.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Alarm, derate, or enter a safe state when limits are exceeded.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Rapid excursions can cause damage before response.

countermeasures.name: Hardware Watchdogs & Self-Test
countermeasures.description: Detect hardware or low-level software faults and recover or place the system in a safe state.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Include startup, periodic, and event-triggered diagnostics.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Common-mode hardware failures may defeat diagnostics.

countermeasures.name: Infrastructure Dependency Mapping
countermeasures.description: Identify facility, network, power, cooling, time, DNS, storage, and other infrastructure required for safe operation.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Define criticality, monitoring, and fallback for each dependency.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Site-specific dependencies may be discovered only after deployment.

countermeasures.name: Recovery after Power / Infrastructure Interruption
countermeasures.description: Ensure restart preserves data integrity, configuration, patient association, and safe clinical state.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Test abrupt power loss and partial dependency recovery.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Interrupted procedures may require manual reconciliation.

countermeasures.name: Manual Threat Review
countermeasures.description: Route threats that do not map reliably to an established countermeasure class for expert review.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Capture why classification failed and whether the taxonomy, threat wording, or classifier should be changed.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Manual review is slower and can be inconsistent.

countermeasures.name: Apply Baseline Security & Safety Controls
countermeasures.description: Until a threat is classified, maintain the product's standard baseline controls rather than inventing a threat-specific mitigation.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Use the organization's approved minimum security, privacy, safety, and quality baseline.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Baseline controls may not address the threat's actual mechanism.

countermeasures.name: Request Additional Threat Context
countermeasures.description: Obtain or generate additional information needed to determine the affected asset, failure mechanism, and plausible damage.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Prefer clarifying threat text over forcing a low-confidence class assignment.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Additional context may still be insufficient.

countermeasures.name: Taxonomy Gap Tracking
countermeasures.description: Track recurring undefined threats to identify missing or poorly scoped countermeasure classes.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Review UNDEFINED frequency and semantic clusters after each classification batch.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Rare but important classes may take time to emerge statistically.

countermeasures.name: Conservative Escalation for High-Severity Unknowns
countermeasures.description: Escalate undefined threats with potentially high patient, privacy, security, or business impact for priority analysis.
countermeasures.implementation_notes: Use severity and uncertainty rather than classifier confidence alone.
countermeasures.residual_risk: Conservative escalation can create review workload.
